summary: Tested the manual GPay + owner approval flow end to end. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (new test_gpay_flow.py plus the cleaned-up backend_test.py). Frontend: storefront INR prices, product -> checkout -> /pay, GPay number and amount, the QR placeholder, server 422 on short UTR shown in pay-error, the pending page, the /pay redirect for pending and paid orders, the paid download (sample txt), and rejected -> retry -> resubmit all work. Admin endpoints return 401 without a token or with an invalid one. The signed-in admin UI could not be tested because there are no owner credentials.

minor.issue: If the order's product was deleted, p is None and p.get() raises a 500. get_object failures also come back as an unhandled 500.
Length is checked before strip(), so a whitespace-padded short ID like '   ab   ' passes and saves a 2-char UTR.
No state guard: an awaiting_payment order (no UTR yet) can be approved through the API, and a paid order can be rejected.

ui_bugs.issue: An invalid or unknown session or product id leaves the page stuck on 'Loading payment details…' forever. The axios calls have no .catch and there is no not-found state.

integration_issues.issue: act() and add() have no try/catch, so failures are silent and there is no loading state.
Only a 403 on /admin/products sets denied. A 401 (expired token) leaves a blank dashboard with no message.

issues: The empty QR placeholder fills about 300px of the viewport, pushing the GPay number and UTR input below the fold. Consider a compact placeholder when has_qr is false.
The QR placeholder text (#87928a on #fff, about 3.2:1) is low contrast and hard to read.

action_items: Add error/not-found handling to PayPage, Success and Checkout so they don't load forever on a bad id.
Guard the download endpoint against a missing product or a storage error (return 404/502, not 500).
Strip transaction_id before validating its length (Pydantic validator).
Restrict approve to pending_review orders (and reject to pending_review) on the backend.
Add try/catch and feedback to the admin approve/reject and add-product actions, and handle 401 in Admin load.
Make the empty QR placeholder compact on mobile and raise its text contrast.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is minified into 25 very long lines (one per component). That is hard to maintain and review; split it into component files.
is_admin returns True for everyone when CLERK_SECRET_KEY == ''. That is risky if the key is ever blanked; prefer failing closed.
require_user fallback when the clerk_auth import fails returns a fake user; is_admin still blocks it unless ADMIN_EMAIL logic changes. Make that import failure loud.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_gpay* orders during testing, all deleted afterwards. test_gpay_flow.py cleans up its own orders.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty. No owner (Ysrilekha348@gmail.com) credentials, so the signed-in admin UI, QR upload and approve/reject UI were not tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_gpay_flow.py reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME via dotenv_values (only those keys) to flip order status, simulating owner approval. No QR is uploaded yet (has_qr false). Admin UI is still untested with a real owner session; a +clerk_test user would only reach the 'Owners only' denied screen because ADMIN_EMAIL is Ysrilekha348@gmail.com.
